Tracked here, unmodified members of that archive:
  bin/2KXP/i386/ahcint.sys  ScsiPort miniport, i386 (Windows 2000/XP/2003 x86)
  bin/2KXP/ahcint.inf       GUI-mode / Device Manager INF (PCI\CC_010601)
  bin/2KXP/txtsetup.oem     F6 file (reference only; USOS integrates through
                            TXTSETUP.SIF instead)
  src/                      the complete source of the tag (corresponding
                            source of ahcint.sys, GPLv3 section 6); identical
                            to src/ of the release archive
Not used: the 9X, NT (3.5x/4.0) and amd64 builds.

The driver matches class 01-06-01 (AHCI) plus AMD 1022:7901, 1022:43C8,
1022:43EB and Intel 2828/2829/2922/2681 (src/ahcimain.c
AhciPciConfigIsAhci). Polling I/O (no interrupts), no NCQ, 128 KB per
request, 64-bit LBA since 1.3.0.0.

USOS changes when staging (tools/w2k_stage.sh): the INF's [SourceDisksNames]
and [SourceDisksNames.x86] row 1 get the path \i386\ahcint (a second
ahcint.sys goes to that folder of the local source, as for xhci98). Nothing
else in the INF and nothing in the .sys is changed.
